intro: Finland's economy grew from forests and paper into high technology, from Nokia phones to Angry Birds.

chapters.title: Tech and games
text: Nokia was once the world's largest mobile phone maker and now builds network equipment. Finnish game studios created Angry Birds and Clash of Clans, and a Finnish student, Linus Torvalds, created the Linux operating system in 1991.

chapters.title: Forests and power
text: Forests supply wood, pulp and paper, a major export. Finland has some of Europe's newest nuclear reactors and is building the world's first deep underground store for spent nuclear fuel.
